title: ENVELLCRAFT
description: the best and only server for heroes of envell
body:
This is my server, which has been online for 3-4 months. It's relatively small, but its main feature is that it has the heroes of envell mod by hbifn.
our server is a regular server (at first glance) where you can survive, and in the regular world you can do everything you do in Minecraft, but to enter the Enwell world you need to craft a laptop! find its crafting yourself! 
the server can attract you probably because there is a place for everyone for example a person wants to play without mods in a regular anarchy he can safely survive in a regular world where nothing changes and rarely go to enwell or you play with a friend want to be in enwell and a friend in a regular world then you can go to enwell and a friend will stay in a regular world or you just want to survive in the world of enwell you will not interfere !in any case rarely but you will have to go to a regular world!
!Mods required if you don't trust the modpack!
heroes of envell-modrinth
heroes of envell overworld-planet minecraft
geckolib-modrinth
packetfixer-modrinth
Welcome to ENVELLCRAFT
